5001.name: DIAMETER_ERROR_USER_UNKNOWN
5001.meaning: Subscriber is not known by the queried subscriber database.
recommended_checks: Confirm the subscriber profile is active.

5003.name: DIAMETER_ERROR_IDENTITY_NOT_REGISTERED
5003.meaning: User identity is not currently registered.

5004.name: DIAMETER_ERROR_ROAMING_NOT_ALLOWED
5004.meaning: Subscriber is not allowed to roam in the current network.
recommended_checks: Check roaming agreement and subscriber barring.
